values.note: Full-hookup sites C$54 a night (30 A) or C$64 (50 A) plus tax, summer and winter alike; 28-day rates C$975 (30 A) / C$1,175 (50 A) in summer, C$800-960 in winter. Campspot also sells 15-amp 'RV OVERFLOW' and 'EQUESTRIAN RV' sites (back-in, described 'First Come, First Serve') at C$32. Every Campspot booking adds a C$5 booking fee once and a 'General Service Fee' of 2% of the site charge a night; GST 5% on top. Cancelling a daily booking costs C$25 with 7 days' notice.
